grafana.summary: Grafana is an open-source platform for monitoring and observability.
grafana.what_it_does: It allows users to visualize and analyze metrics from various data sources, creating dashboards for monitoring systems and applications.
grafana.best_for: DevOps engineers, system administrators, and developers needing to visualize and monitor time-series data.
grafana.free_tier: Grafana OSS is free and open-source. Grafana Cloud offers a free tier with limitations.
grafana.limitations: The free tier of Grafana Cloud has limits on data retention, query volume, and features. Paid plans offer more resources and capabilities.
grafana.licensing_notes: Grafana is available as open-source software (OSS). Grafana Cloud offers a free tier and paid plans.

faq.question: Is Grafana free?
faq.answer: Yes, Grafana is available as free and open-source software (Grafana OSS). Grafana Cloud also provides a free tier for users.

faq.question: What are the benefits of Grafana Cloud?
faq.answer: Grafana Cloud offers a managed service with features like scalable data storage, advanced alerting, and integrations, with free and paid tiers available.

dbeaver.summary: DBeaver is a universal database tool and SQL client.
dbeaver.what_it_does: It allows users to connect to various databases, browse schemas, execute SQL queries, and manage database objects.
dbeaver.best_for: Database administrators, developers, and analysts who work with multiple database systems.
dbeaver.free_tier: DBeaver Community Edition is free and open-source.
dbeaver.limitations: The Enterprise Edition offers additional features, drivers, and support not found in the free Community Edition.
dbeaver.licensing_notes: DBeaver Community Edition is free under the Apache License. DBeaver Enterprise Edition requires a paid license.

faq.question: Is DBeaver free?
faq.answer: Yes, DBeaver Community Edition is free and open-source. An Enterprise Edition with additional features is available for purchase.

faq.question: What is the difference between DBeaver Community and Enterprise editions?
faq.answer: The Community Edition provides core database management tools for various databases. The Enterprise Edition includes advanced features, commercial database support, and enhanced tooling.
